tasks.query: 爱 普 生 smart panel
tasks.query_intent: User is searching for Epson Smart Panel, the official Epson app to manage, scan, and print with Epson printers.

evidence.note: Epson Smart Panel is the official Epson printer companion; the ad is a third-party printer scan and print utility.

tasks.relationship_analysis: Same core need — printer scanning and printing management — via a non-Epson alternative app.
tasks.comment: [Query Intent] The query "爱 普 生 smart panel" indicates the user wants Epson's official Smart Panel app for managing Epson printer scan and print functions. [Ad Analysis] The advertised app "Smart Printer App Scan & Print" is a third-party mobile utility for scanning and printing with printers. [Relevance Breakdown] Both address the same printer management and scan-to-print workflow; users searching for one printer control app commonly consider alternative utilities that provide the same function. [Why not higher/lower] Not Excellent because it is not the official Epson app searched; not Acceptable because the functional overlap in printer scan and print control is direct and strong. Rated Good.
